proves.claim: The pulled landing offer over a mechanical-only conflict keeps the accepted item verified and takes it.

cli.io-landing-pull.mechanical-only-conf.why: Without it, a cells-plan row conflict reopens every accepted item and each needs a re-review of identical work.

proves.claim: The pulled landing offer over a real conflict reopens the accepted item to its lane naming the file.

cli.io-landing-pull.real-conflict-reopen.why: Without it, wiring the mechanical reader could let a conflict no rule resolves land.
